text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel decided to enter the Kikuka 
Sho. With just one week left until the 
race, news broke that Biwa Hayahide had 
been temporarily hospitalized.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though stated to be for physical 
conditioning, speculations among fans 
regarding Biwa Hayahide were still flying 
wildly even on the day of the Kikuka-sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing baseless rumors, Sakura Laurel was 
worried about Narita Brian, concerned that 
such an atmosphere would make it 
impossible for her to concentrate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian, however, paid it no mind. 
She kept her focus solely on the race 
ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel braced herself, knowing that 
she was the one who needed to focus most. 
To chase after her idol— she threw herself 
into it with single-minded devotion.
